verdict.rationale: Expensify's SmartScan and AI features are marketed to auto-capture merchant, date, amount, categorize, tag, and attach receipts in real time, with finalized reports auto-exporting to QuickBooks for close (expensify-docs-3, expensify-docs-4, expensify-docs-6, expensify-docs-7). However, hands-on community reports describe categorization failing roughly 70% of the time unless obvious, human (MTurk) review of receipts introducing PII exposure, and slow/inconsistent processing — directly undermining the 'coded as it happens, accurately' claim (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-2, expensify-comm-4, expensify-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent verification of current AI categorization accuracy, resolution of the MTurk/privacy issue, and evidence that memo/category fields require no manual correction before close.
